note: Alberta Parks campground on the east shore of Park Lake, 17 km NW of Lethbridge, in two loops: North 'A' along the shore (powered sites in a shady cottonwood grove, unserviced sites along the water) and South 'B' near the beach, with larger powered sites and a playground. Group camps; firewood at the park office. --Claude
